instruction: Save the webpage I'm viewing as a PDF file to the Desktop with the default filename, using landscape orientation.

metadata.explanation: Task requires saving the webpage as PDF in landscape orientation to Desktop. Evaluator verifies that the PDF file exists at the expected location and contains at least 1 page. Uses custom getter to extract PDF metadata (exists, page_count, file_size) and custom metric to verify file existence and minimum page count.
metadata.verification_details: Verified that PDF file path matches Chrome's default naming pattern for the webpage title. Minimum page count set to 1 as the webpage contains substantial content that will generate at least one PDF page in landscape orientation.

llm_judge_reasons: PASS: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements - file existence, location (Desktop), page count (min 1), and landscape orientation.
PASS: Getter extracts orientation by reading PDF page mediabox dimensions and comparing width vs height (pdf.py:41-56). Correctly determines landscape when width > height.
PASS: Metric checks orientation match (pdf.py:29-34). Compares result orientation against expected orientation and returns 0.0 if mismatch.

PASS: Expected parameter handling is correct. When expected.type='rule', the metric receives rules dict directly and correctly accesses keys via expected.get('min_pages') and expected.get('orientation').
PASS: Getter always returns a dict (never None), so type compatibility with metric is correct.
PASS: File path includes Desktop location and default filename pattern matching webpage title. No postconfig needed since PDF persists after saving.
PASS: Complete coverage of all instruction requirements with appropriate error handling (try/except in getter).
